QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Stars Falling into the Dead Mine
QuestInfo.1: Scadur says the light was from the falling stars. He felt it was ominous that the light fell into the #bDead Mine#k.\r\n\r\nRelay this story to #bAlcaster#k.
QuestInfo.2: You told Alcaster everything Scadur said, from the light being the falling stars and how he felt it was ominous that the light fell into the #bDead Mine#k.\r\n
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 323,465
Can proceed to [Star Force] Surveying the Dead Mine

0.0: Last night, I was tracking a huge White Fang across a field. I was looking at the sky, judging the light, when an overwhelming sense of foreboding hit me.
0.1: The field started quaking, and the western sky turned red as fire. Then that star shot across and fell into the #bDead Mine#k. I booked it right back here to El Nath. I got me a strong survivor's instinct, see, and I knew staying there wouldn't be safe. And that's my tale. Tell it to #bAlcaster#k, would you?

yes.0: Go tell #bAlcaster#k. I've got things to take care of.\r\n

no.0: Something bad is happening. Trust me on that one.

1.msg: (You tell Alcaster what Scadur told you.)

yes.0: The Dead Mine? And Scadur got a bad feeling from the light, too? Oh my... \r\n
